$comment: The Disciplines a first-year can take (the three launch cities), each with its first three techniques and what its students bring to the sparring ladder. Effects the fight knows: volley, mark, finisher, sound, pull, quake, heavy, burst, dash. Keys 1, 2 and 3 in the fight. Every number is a knob.

marshal.name: Marshal
marshal.school: the Marshals' school: the law carried by hand, and the shot that ends an argument

techniques.name: Covering Fire
techniques.text: Three quick shots of field at the foe you face, whatever is in your hand.

techniques.name: Warrant
techniques.text: Name the foe under the law: for eight seconds, everything that lands on it lands harder.

techniques.name: Last Round
techniques.text: One shot, held for the end: twice the harm on a foe that is staggered or nearly done.

techniques.name: Rake
techniques.text: A low sweep of field that knocks the foe off its feet and back.

techniques.name: Pin
techniques.text: A mark on the foe that holds it where it stands for a breath.

techniques.name: Enfilade
techniques.text: Five shots down the line, each weaker than the last.

techniques.name: Breaching Charge
techniques.text: The field throws you at the foe and the blow lands as you arrive.

techniques.name: Ward Line
techniques.text: A line of field at your feet that turns the next blow aside.

techniques.name: The Last Word
techniques.text: One shot, held for a foe that is already broken: it ends what is nearly ended.

pilot.name: Pilot
pilot.school: the Pilots' school: reading the current, the line across the gap, and the weight of the turn

techniques.name: Sounding
techniques.text: Read the water: the world slows round the foe for a breath, and its next move shows.

techniques.name: Line Across
techniques.text: A line of field across the gap: it bites, and the foe comes to you.

techniques.name: Capstan
techniques.text: Wind up and turn: everything within reach is thrown.

techniques.name: Heave
techniques.text: The capstan's whole weight through the staff: a blow that staggers.

techniques.name: Lead Line
techniques.text: A sounding thrown at the foe: for a while every blow finds it.

techniques.name: Undertow
techniques.text: The current pulls the foe to you, off its feet.

techniques.name: Breaker
techniques.text: The deck lifts under everything near you.

techniques.name: Steerage
techniques.text: A long step through the water to the foe, the hook first.

techniques.name: Fathom
techniques.text: A sounding of the whole arena: every foe in it is named and slowed.

aeronaut.name: Aeronaut
aeronaut.school: the Aeronauts' school: the line, the drop, and the vent that clears a deck

techniques.name: Grapple Line
techniques.text: Throw the line and go: the field hauls you across the gap into a strike.

techniques.name: Vent
techniques.text: Vent the field all round you: steam, fire, and a scald that lingers.

techniques.name: Ballast
techniques.text: Drop everything: the ground takes the weight, and everything near is thrown off its feet.

techniques.name: Downdraft
techniques.text: The envelope's vent turned on the foe: a wall of air and a blow.

techniques.name: Tether
techniques.text: A grapple-line that holds the foe to you: it cannot gallop away.

techniques.name: Flare
techniques.text: Burning gas thrown at the foe's feet.

techniques.name: Skyhook
techniques.text: The grapple takes the foe and the line hauls it to you.

techniques.name: Drop Anchor
techniques.text: The ballast dropped: everything near you is thrown.

techniques.name: Lift
techniques.text: A breath of lift that takes you out of the next blow's way.

engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.school: the Colonia works: the field in brass pipes, pressure, and the governor that keeps it

techniques.name: Bind Engine
techniques.text: A coupling of field thrown round the foe: it drags a brass weight and slows.

techniques.name: Overpressure
techniques.text: The engine-arm vents: scalding field thrown in a cone, and the foe burns.

techniques.name: Governor
techniques.text: The governor closes: for a while nothing that strikes you gets through.

techniques.name: Piston
techniques.text: The arm fires: one blow with the whole engine behind it.

techniques.name: Boiler Burst
techniques.text: Everything round you is thrown by the pressure let go.

techniques.name: Gauge
techniques.text: The foe is measured: for a while every blow finds the seam.

techniques.name: Winch
techniques.text: A line and a winch: the foe is reeled in.

techniques.name: Rivet Gun
techniques.text: Four rivets of field, fast.

techniques.name: Decommission
techniques.text: One charge saved for a broken engine: it ends it.

legionary.name: Legionary
legionary.school: the Tiber line: the shield wall, the three beats, and the pilum that opens it

techniques.name: Testudo
techniques.text: The shield up and the field behind it: nothing gets through for a while.

techniques.name: Volley
techniques.text: Three pila of field thrown in a flight.

techniques.name: Decimation
techniques.text: The blow kept for the broken: it falls the way a line falls.

techniques.name: Shield Bash
techniques.text: The scutum's rim into the foe: it goes back.

techniques.name: Advance
techniques.text: Three steps and the blade: the line comes to the foe.

techniques.name: Stamp
techniques.text: The whole wall stamps once; the ground answers.

techniques.name: Centurion's Eye
techniques.text: The foe is called out; the line hits it where it is called.

techniques.name: Fire Pot
techniques.text: A pot of burning field thrown at the feet.

techniques.name: Cornu
techniques.text: The horn: everything that hears it slows for a breath.

grower.name: Grower
grower.school: the Khemet fields: wards planted, thorns raised, the bloom that mends the ground

techniques.name: Graft
techniques.text: A thorn-seed grafted into the foe: it burns from the inside.

techniques.name: Thorn Wall
techniques.text: A wall of thorns raised at your feet: it turns the next blows.

techniques.name: Bloom
techniques.text: The ground blooms under everything near; roots throw it.

techniques.name: Reap
techniques.text: The sickle's wide swing, with the field in it.

techniques.name: Creeper
techniques.text: A creeper of field round the foe's legs.

techniques.name: Pollen
techniques.text: A cloud of pollen: everything in it slows.

techniques.name: Seed Shot
techniques.text: Five seeds of iron thrown in a fan.

techniques.name: Root Pull
techniques.text: Roots take the foe and drag it to the ward.

techniques.name: Blight
techniques.text: The foe is blighted: for a while it takes every blow harder.

geometer.name: Geometer
geometer.school: the Baghdad house of figures: the field measured, the chord drawn, the figure solved

techniques.name: Chord
techniques.text: A chord drawn through the foe: when the figure is already broken, it closes it.

techniques.name: Bisect
techniques.text: The foe is bisected on the page: every blow finds the line.

techniques.name: Orrery
techniques.text: The orrery turns; everything inside it moves slower.

techniques.name: Tangent
techniques.text: Three shots on tangents that all arrive.

techniques.name: Circumscribe
techniques.text: A circle drawn round you: nothing crosses it for a while.

techniques.name: Radius
techniques.text: A radius of field fixed on the foe: it cannot leave the circle quickly.

techniques.name: Proof
techniques.text: The glass blade's one straight line.

techniques.name: Translation
techniques.text: You are moved along the line to the foe.

techniques.name: Theorem
techniques.text: Everything near is proved and thrown.

ascetic.name: Ascetic
ascetic.school: the Varanasi steps: breath, Still, and the body as the field's only instrument

techniques.name: Breath Hold
techniques.text: The breath held and the field with it: nothing lands for a while.

techniques.name: Ash Step
techniques.text: A step through the ash to the foe, the fist arriving first.

techniques.name: Mantra
techniques.text: A word said once: everything that hears it slows.

techniques.name: Palm
techniques.text: The open hand with the whole field behind it.

techniques.name: Stamp of Still
techniques.text: One stamp; the ground forgets to hold the foe up.

techniques.name: Ember Fist
techniques.text: A blow that leaves a coal in the foe.

techniques.name: Hold
techniques.text: The foe is held by a breath it did not take.

techniques.name: Chakram Wheel
techniques.text: Three rings thrown and gathered.

techniques.name: Last Breath
techniques.text: The blow saved for a foe already falling.

examiner.name: Examiner
examiner.school: the Jiangnan halls: the field as a sentence, written, sealed, and read aloud

techniques.name: Ink Seal
techniques.text: The seal set on the foe: every blow finds the character.

techniques.name: Edict
techniques.text: The edict read: everything that hears it stands still a breath.

techniques.name: Verdict
techniques.text: The verdict, written once, for a foe already judged.

techniques.name: Red Ink
techniques.text: A stroke of burning ink across the foe.

techniques.name: Sealed Door
techniques.text: A door of field sealed before you.

techniques.name: Summons
techniques.text: The foe is summoned and cannot leave quickly.

techniques.name: Needle Rain
techniques.text: Five needles of field in a fan.

techniques.name: Brushstroke
techniques.text: One stroke across the gap, the brush landing first.

techniques.name: Full Stop
techniques.text: The sentence ended with the brush-staff's whole weight.

rider.name: Rider
rider.school: the Kazan steppe: the charge, the wheel, and the bow loosed at the gallop

techniques.name: Mount
techniques.text: The field carries you as a horse would: across the gap into the lance.

techniques.name: Wheel
techniques.text: The whole troop wheels: everything round you is ridden down.

techniques.name: Loose
techniques.text: Three arrows at the gallop.

techniques.name: Lasso
techniques.text: The whip takes the foe round the neck and brings it.

techniques.name: Quarry
techniques.text: The foe is named the quarry: every blow finds it.

techniques.name: Couched Lance
techniques.text: The lance set and the field behind it.

techniques.name: Hobble
techniques.text: The foe's legs are hobbled by a line of field.

techniques.name: Mercy Shot
techniques.text: One arrow kept for the broken.

techniques.name: Horn of the Steppe
techniques.text: The horn: everything that hears it slows.

archivist.name: Archivist
archivist.school: the Timbuktu library: the field written down, annotated, and where it must be, erased

techniques.name: Catalogue
techniques.text: The foe is catalogued: every blow finds the entry.

techniques.name: Annotation
techniques.text: A note in burning ink on the foe's hide.

techniques.name: Erasure
techniques.text: The entry struck out: for a foe already broken, the end.

techniques.name: Binding
techniques.text: A binding of field round you: nothing gets through for a while.

techniques.name: Reading Aloud
techniques.text: The page read aloud: everything that hears it slows.

techniques.name: The Closed Book
techniques.text: The ledger shut on the foe.

techniques.name: Pen Shot
techniques.text: Three pen-knives thrown.

techniques.name: Footnote
techniques.text: The foe is footnoted and cannot get far.

techniques.name: Lantern Fall
techniques.text: The lantern's light dropped on everything near.

blade.name: Blade
blade.school: the Edo schools: the draw on the beat, the harmony of the cut, and the severance

techniques.name: Draw Cut
techniques.text: The blade drawn and the cut made in one: on the beat, it is a Fold.

techniques.name: Harmony
techniques.text: The blade held in harmony with the foe's: its blows do not land for a while.

techniques.name: Severance
techniques.text: The cut kept for the broken: it severs.

techniques.name: Iai
techniques.text: A step and the draw, landing before the foe knows the sheath is empty.

techniques.name: Red Blade
techniques.text: A cut that leaves the wound burning.

techniques.name: Earth Cut
techniques.text: The blade through the ground: everything near is thrown.

techniques.name: Arrow Flight
techniques.text: Three arrows from the long bow.

techniques.name: Named Cut
techniques.text: The cut named before it is made: every blow finds it.

techniques.name: Kiai
techniques.text: The shout: everything that hears it slows.
